docs.text: The opposition was loud when the Canadian government announced Bill C-5 and Ontario announced Bill 5. Scott McLeod, the Lake Huron regional chief for the Anishinabek Nation, has been a vocal critic of the legislation from the onset.

"In its unanimous decision, the Supreme Court stated [in 2024] that the $4 per person annuities, without change since 1875, 'can only be described as a mockery of the Crown’s treaty promise to the Anishinaabe of the upper Great Lakes.'" Canada needs to make this right with a sufficiently high UBI.
